entries.body:
Right now, I am just using this section to describe the 4 "Legacy Modes" that might feel less polished. Because they are.
-----------------

Other Screens - Thruster Control:

Before I made the live control mode, I spent a medium amount of time making this cute little GUI to mimic some flight control panel. I like it so I'm keeping it. You can control thrusters with it, and see Sable sub-level statistics live.
-----------------

Other Screens - Value Panel:

This mode will capture your keyboard just like the Live Controller, but its focused on just changing Create's "Value Panels". If a block has a slider allowing you to flip it from, say, counter-clockwise to clockwise, you could type 0 or 1 to trigger those.
-----------------

Other Screens - CC Peripheral:

TextHere
This screen allows you to see all the CC:Tweaked 'getters' and 'setters' available to a certain peripheral. This is all available to be used in the Sequencer mode, but you can also manually change something here. This screen is a remnant of the old UI, so it will be modernized in a future update.

Other Screens - CC Computer:

TextHere
Live capture mode, allowing you to type on the a CC:Tweaked computer. It is a keyboard, after all.
